decisions.reason: Specifying HubSpot as the reporting platform does not change how lead lists are created or managed.
The reporting-platform clarification does not alter the HubSpot lead task-assignment system.
Creating reports in HubSpot does not change the required visibility of email and LinkedIn communication history.
The reporting decision does not modify the lead-classification mechanisms or their state.
The source decision concerns reporting and does not change the requirement to include lead notes.
HubSpot funnel reporting is distinct from the lead-nurturing workflows and leaves their scope unchanged.
The reporting-platform clarification does not change the MeetAlfred activity values synchronized into HubSpot Lead Status.
Creating HubSpot reports does not modify the HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization direction, objects, or import behavior.
The reporting decision does not change the LinkedIn-to-HubSpot lead-transfer path or timing.
Although both concern HubSpot, identifying HubSpot as the reporting platform does not alter the existing general CRM-configuration requirement.
HubSpot funnel reporting does not change the campaign email integration between MeetAlfred and HubSpot.
The reporting-platform clarification does not affect Apollo enrichment of HubSpot contact data.
